scenes.narration: Two packages want different versions of the same thing. Now what?
Chapter zero ended with pip overwriting one package and reporting success. Hand uv the same impossible request and it refuses — then explains itself in ordinary English.

uvStage.headline: It refuses, and [explains]
uvStage.premise: The same impossible request pip accepted. uv stops, and says why in English.

steps.detail: no overwrite. no success message. a refusal.

scenes.narration: Picture one line with every version of a package on it. Each package lays a bracketed range across it. Where the brackets overlap, there is an answer.

uvStage.headline: Where the brackets [overlap]
uvStage.premise: One line of versions. Each asker lays a bracketed range across it.

scenes.narration: And when they never touch, no answer exists. pytest needs pluggy above one point five. I asked for below one point zero. Opposite ends of the line.

uvStage.headline: Brackets that never [touch]
uvStage.premise: pytest needs pluggy 1.5 or above. You asked for below 1.0. Nothing is in both.

scenes.narration: Loosen one of the two it named. Full course on the channel.
